title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site examples
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds a collection of RAG templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts with runnable examples and docs site updates. Motivation: provide reproducible, opinionated starting points for customers building retrieval-augmented agents and tool-calling flows; reduce onboarding friction and make evals easier to reproduce. Changes include: (1) a set of RAG template configs (basic, conversational, multi-vector) plus example indexer configs for common vector stores; (2) agent quickstarts showing tool registration, function schema, and orchestration patterns in Python and TypeScript; (3) a docs site guide with step-by-step quickstarts, code snippets, and diagrams; (4) a few CI checks to validate example notebooks and docs build links. Checklist: - [x] add templates and example configs - [x] add Python and TS quickstarts and example notebooks - [x] update docs navigation and quickstart pages - [x] add basic link-check CI job - [x] address initial reviewer feedback and fix links Testing notes: example notebooks are run in CI (light smoke runs), docs site builds locally and on CI, unit tests unaffected. Migration/rollout: docs go live on next site deploy; examples published to redwood-examples package. Related: ENG-8792 (RAG quickstarts), DOCS-114 (docs nav update).
